Photo IDs are internal references to the 2026 site-visit photographs (SRC060), listed in Photo_Index; the photographs are not published, not embedded and not in the distributable ZIP.

Status_Terms.Supported: Shape and position both documented by a source.
Status_Terms.Approximate Reconstruction: Position and/or shape partly documented; the rest estimated and labelled.
Status_Terms.Pending Verification: Identity or position not established; not published as an identified part.

Structural_Correction_Phase3.Summary: Phase 2 placed the main bridge one level too high (on top of the 01 deck house) and the training bridge two levels above the 01 deck. The 01 Deck plan (SRC038 p.31) puts the BRIDGE, chart room and nav cabin on the 01 deck; the 02 Signal Deck plan (p.32) puts the TRAINING BRIDGE and the CEREMONIAL PLATFORM on the 02 deck. Phase 3 rebuilt the forward superstructure accordingly.
Changes: 01 deck house shortened to end at X 78.5 m; main bridge rebuilt as a separate lofted block X 78.5–84.2 m on the 01 deck (7.6–10.5 m), chamfered in plan, windows leaning outwards; bridge wings moved down to the 01 deck.
The separate bridge storey between 10.5 and 12.1 m (Phase 2) removed; its roof railing removed.
02 deck edge railing extended forward over the bridge roof, narrowing to the front (p.32).
Training bridge rebuilt on the 02 deck at frames 20 to about 16 (X 74.2–79.8 m), 3.24 m wide, roof 12.95 m; 3 forward windows, 2 side windows per side, doors aft.
STD (As built) moved to the 02 deck: 3.6 m compartment plus director on the octagonal position; octagonal bulwark added for both configurations (STD position / ceremonial platform).
02 deck house resized to the plan (frames 31 to 23½, 5.4 m wide), roof = 03 deck at 12.7 m, with railings.
Ladders 01→02 deck added at frames ~20 to 18½ (p.32); the two Phase 2 ladders at the after end of the 02 deck removed (not on the plan).
Evidence: SRC058 front photograph (training bridge windows directly above the bridge window band)
user photograph supplied 5 Nov 2026 (training bridge side windows)

Components.Name: Unidentified Deck Structure — Pending Verification
Components.Directly_Visible: A tall box-like structure with two windows high on one face, a watertight door with dogs below them, an external handrail, on an open upper deck with guardrails; whip aerials and an air-conditioning unit nearby; open water beyond the guardrail.
Components.From_Deck_Plan: Not identified. Candidates compared on the 02 Signal Deck plan: (a) the after end of the training bridge — the sketch shows doors aft but no windows there, and the photographed face is taller than the 2.45 m estimate; (b) the forward end of the 02 deck house (training office, frames ~23½) — the plan shows a W.T.D. on that face and whip aerials at frames ~22 and ~18, which would fit, but no photograph shows the structure together with the training bridge or the foremast.
Components.Estimated_or_Inferred: Not modelled as a separate part and not named in the public explorer: its position is unknown. Evidence needed: a photograph showing it with a known feature (foremast, training bridge, funnel), the direction the camera faced, or a note from the site visit.
